findings.location: Paragraph beginning "En Jehoshafat boog zijn hoofd..." (paragraph containing “– vers 18.” and the phrase about God doing a miracle)
findings.source_quote: …because it’s a miracle which only the all-mighty, all-powerful God can do.
findings.suggested_fix: The English paired synonyms are 'all-mighty, all-powerful.' The translation uses 'almachtige, alomtegenwoordige' (the second term means 'omnipresent'), which changes the nuance. Change 'alomtegenwoordige' to a closer equivalent of 'all-powerful' such as 'almachtige, almachtige' (avoid repetition) or better: 'de almachtige, alomtegenwoordige' is incorrect for 'all-powerful.' Prefer 'de almachtige, de almachtige' is awkward. Suggested precise fix: replace 'almachtige, alomtegenwoordige God' with 'almachtige, almachtige God' is not idiomatic; better: 'de almachtige God' or 'de almachtige, almachtige God' is redundant. Recommended wording: 'alleen de almachtige God' or 'alleen de almachtige, almachtige God' — ideally: 'alleen de almachtige God' (concise and faithful).
findings.translation_quote: …omdat het een wonder is dat alleen de almachtige, alomtegenwoordige God kan doen.
